description: F-TAX-003: the tax profile the engine is running on is readable. `setTaxProfile` changed it and nothing reported it, so an embedding could display only what it had written itself — the same value by construction in that one embedding, which is a property of the caller and not a guarantee. It belongs in `systemDescription` rather than in a projection of its own: that is the projection which already describes the tenant, and a Verfahrensdokumentation has to state which taxation method the books were kept under. Additive. Reported by an embedding application as the second half of its F-16.

steps.comment: A mid-year election, so the reported profile is one the engine holds and not the one the setup passed.

expect.comment: Der Mandant wird beschrieben — und dazu gehört, unter welcher Versteuerungsart die Bücher geführt wurden.
